description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractLogger' which implements the 'LoggerInterface'. It provides default implementations for various logging methods like emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, info, and debug, each delegating to a central 'log' method. It serves as a base class for custom loggers in the PSR (PHP Standards Recommendations) logging standard.

classes.name: AbstractLogger
classes.description: An abstract class providing default implementations of logging methods, delegating calls to the 'log' method, designed to be inherited by specific logger implementations.

methods.description: Logs an emergency level message by delegating to the 'log' method.
